title: 第292章 一氧化碳中毒第291章 干了
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
李大炮可不是说着玩的，既然说干，那就得好好干。
他立即回去和周念瑶一起研究，该怎么打造这个冰雪小世界，不能让游客花冤枉钱，必须得让他们觉得物有所值。
“大炮，你现在在哪？赶紧回来一趟。”
孟晚晴忽然打电话过来，听她说话有些着急的样子，似乎村里出事了。
“我就在大黑驴镇，怎么了？”李大炮问道。
“大牛和桂芬一家，好像是一氧化碳中毒了，你赶紧回来救人。”孟晚晴说道。
“一氧化碳中毒了。”
李大炮二话不说赶紧回村，估计是烧煤取暖通风没做好，所以才导致一氧化碳中毒。
关键他家里还有四个丫头，这要是一起中毒出事的话，还不得直接上新闻。
“不会出事吧？”
周念瑶也担心，心中只能期待着没事。
牛犊子村，所有人都聚集在李大牛家里，要不是有人发现了他们，只怕都要躺板板了。
“这个大牛，裤子只脱一半，也太省事了吧。”
“天气冷脱，一半就可以了，不然冻坏了怎么办？”
“有句话怎么说来着？人在花下死，做鬼也风流。”
……
村民们还在开口打趣，因为李大牛和王桂芬两个人衣衫不整，很明显在中毒前，两个人还在干坏事。
这下尴尬了，村民们把他们抬出来的时候，啥都看到了。
“让开让开，大家都让开一点，保持通风。”
孟晚晴连忙说道，她是村里的村支书，出了这种事，她也得负责任。

王美琴和叶秋玲翘首以盼，希望李大炮赶紧回来，只要他回来了，肯定能够把他们救回来。
李大炮用上了最快的速度，没有骑三轮车，直接施展轻功身法，不需要绕路，以直线赶了回来。
他几乎是从天而降，来到了人群之中，出现在孟晚晴的身边。
“大炮。”
孟晚晴惊呼一声，看到他出现，立即松了一口气。
李大炮赶紧救人，他们中毒很深，不过这难不倒他。
“回春术！”
李大炮用仙术救人，不需要动用银色的功德灵液，这点小问题，用一个仙术就可以治好。
果然，在他的回春术治疗下，李大牛他们逐一醒了过来。
“我这是怎么了？”
李大牛一脸懵逼，不知道发生了什么状况。
王桂芬也一样，他们的裤子已经被好心的村民提上，不然肯定会想起来之前在干嘛。
“大牛桂芬，你们中毒了，都说你们家的炕要好好的修一修了，这不就出事了。”
“还好大炮及时赶回来，不然后果不堪设想，赶紧感谢一下大炮的救命之恩吧。”
“也不知道我们这里什么时候能够通暖气，靠煤炭来取暖实在是太不安全了。”
村民们七嘴八舌，看到这样的事情发生，不少年轻的少妇都担心起来。
因为她们都有孩子，他们可不想这样的事情发生。
李大牛和王桂芬反应了过来，他们也想起了之前发生了什么事。
李大牛又按照李大炮说的方法修炼了一个小时，然后迫不及待的想要试验效果，结果就出事了。
“大炮，太谢谢你了。”

王桂芬连忙感谢，对李大牛已经非常无语，都说要修炼一个月才有效果，每次都得来折腾她。
关键每次折腾都不行，他倒是可以继续修炼去，反而把她弄得不上不下。
“没事，以后小心一点，一定要注意安全。”
content_en:
Li Dapao is not just joking. Since he says he will do it, he must do it well.
He immediately went back to study with Zhou Nianyao on how to create this small world of ice and snow so that tourists could not waste their money and make them feel that they were worth their money.
"Cannon, where are you now? Come back quickly."
Meng Wanqing called suddenly. She looked a little anxious when she spoke, as if something had happened in the village.
"I'm in Dahei Donkey Town, what's wrong?" Li Dapao asked.
"Daniu and Guifen's family seem to be suffering from carbon monoxide poisoning. Come back quickly to save them," Meng Wanqing said.
"Carbon monoxide poisoning."
Li Dapao hurried back to the village without saying anything. He probably burned coal for heating and ventilation and did not do a good job, which led to carbon monoxide poisoning.
The key point is that he still has four girls at home. If there is a poisoning accident, it will not be directly on the news.
"Is nothing going to happen?"
Zhou Nianyao was also worried and could only hope that everything would be fine.
In Niuduzi Village, everyone gathered at Li Daniu's house. If someone hadn't discovered them, they would have been lying on the bed.
"You're such a big guy, it's so easy to only take off your pants halfway."
"It's cold weather, so half is enough. Otherwise, what if you get frozen?"
"What's the saying? A person can die under flowers and become a ghost."
…
The villagers were still joking because Li Daniu and Wang Guifen were disheveled. It was obvious that they were still doing bad things before they were poisoned.
It was embarrassing now. When the villagers carried them out, they saw everything.
"Move out of the way, everyone, please move out of the way and maintain ventilation."
Meng Wanqing quickly said that she was the village party secretary, and she had to take responsibility if something like this happened.
Wang Meiqin and Ye Qiuling were looking forward to it, hoping that Li Dapao would come back soon. As long as he came back, he would definitely be able to rescue them.
Li Dapao used the fastest speed. Instead of riding a tricycle, he directly used Qinggong and body techniques. He did not need to take a detour and rushed back in a straight line.
He almost fell from the sky, came to the crowd, and appeared next to Meng Wanqing.
"Cannon."
Meng Wanqing exclaimed, and immediately breathed a sigh of relief when she saw him appearing.
Li Dapao hurriedly rescued the people. They were deeply poisoned, but this didn't bother him.
"Rejuvenation!"
Li Dapao used immortal magic to save people. He didn't need to use the silver spirit of merit. This small problem could be cured with just one immortal magic.
Sure enough, under his rejuvenation treatment, Li Daniu and the others woke up one by one.
"What's wrong with me?"
Li Daniu looked confused, not knowing what happened.
The same goes for Wang Guifen. Their pants have been pulled up by kind-hearted villagers, otherwise they would definitely remember what they were doing before.
"Daniu Guifen, you have been poisoned. They all say that your kang needs to be repaired. Isn't something wrong?"
"Fortunately, Cannon came back in time, otherwise the consequences would have been disastrous. Let's quickly thank Cannon for saving his life."
"I don't know when we will be able to have heating here. It's really unsafe to rely on coal for heating."
The villagers were all talking, and many young women became worried when they saw such a thing happening.
Because they both have children, they don't want this to happen.
Li Daniu and Wang Guifen reacted, and they also remembered what happened before.
Li Daniu practiced according to the method Li Dapao said for another hour, and then he couldn't wait to test the effect, but something happened.
"Cannon, thank you so much."
Wang Guifen quickly thanked her and was very speechless towards Li Daniu. He said that it would take a month of practice to have any effect, so he had to torment her every time.
The key point is that every time it fails, he can continue to practice, but it makes her unable to get better or worse.
"It's okay. Be careful in the future and be sure to pay attention to safety."
